SCOPE: Implement only the bounded F84 arm/context contract slice in the isolated copy. Preserve existing learn-v1 records and readers. Add a backward-compatible versioned representation that can include caption style, server-owned hook type, server-owned format, and the existing scheduled UTC bucket. Feed that representation through existing exemplar arm derivation, guidance selection, posterior/bandit refresh, and publication-recipe evidence where those paths already exist. Keep the existing exploration floor, model/platform/context scoping, A/B winner feedback, tenant/RLS boundaries, cross-model privacy, and unavailable-evidence semantics. Do not create a parallel learning subsystem or schema unless existing source contracts prove one is required.
TRUST_RULE: Hook and format may enter learning only from existing server-owned verified recipe/guidance evidence. Reject or ignore client-supplied, unverified, malformed, or cross-model evidence; never infer a hook or format from arbitrary provider payloads.
PASS_CRITERIA: (1) Existing learn-v1 fixtures and readers remain compatible. (2) Known trusted hook/format evidence produces a deterministic versioned arm/context without changing caption-only fallback behavior when evidence is absent. (3) Selection and posterior updates use the versioned key without mixing incompatible contexts. (4) Tests prove known, absent, malformed, untrusted, and cross-model evidence cases plus A/B winner and exploration behavior. (5) Focused worker tests, typecheck, and applicable lint/build commands pass with real exit codes. (6) Delivery lists exact changed paths, per-file SHA-256 values, commands, exits, and TEST_RESULT.
REQUIRED_DELIVERY: Publish one flat DELIVERY artifact under DELIVERY_ROOT with changed-file hashes, exact test commands and exits, a concise compatibility note, and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. If any criterion cannot be met, publish one terminal BLOCKED/NACK naming the exact file or contract blocker and the next owner.
DO_NOT_TOUCH: source checkout writes, installer, bridge implementation, deployment, live database, migrations against any host, runtime services, containers, systemd, provider calls, credentials, permissions, ACLs, publication, external network, commit, push, or files outside COPY_ROOT and DELIVERY_ROOT
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
PAYLOAD_SHA256: NONE
